topics.Game Theory & Networks: Economic theory of strategic interaction: Nash equilibrium, repeated and dynamic games, bargaining, cooperative games, network formation and network games.
topics.Mechanism & Market Design: Economic theory of mechanism design, incentive compatibility, auctions, matching, allocation rules, and market design.
topics.Information & Contracts: Economic theory of asymmetric information, information design, Bayesian persuasion, signaling, screening, principal-agent models and contract theory.
topics.Decision & Social Choice: Economic theory of preferences, choice axioms, decisions under uncertainty, expected utility, voting, social choice, aggregation and welfare.
topics.Equilibrium & Mathematical Economics: Microeconomic theory foundations of competitive general equilibrium, production and exchange economies, equilibrium existence and uniqueness, welfare theorems and mathematical foundations of preferences.
topics.Industrial Organization Theory: Microeconomic theory of oligopoly, Cournot and Bertrand competition, monopoly pricing, market entry, search, platforms and strategic firm behavior.

negative_prototypes: An empirical economics paper estimating causal effects using regression, difference in differences, instrumental variables, survey data or field experiments.
A quantitative macroeconomics or finance paper calibrated to data to forecast returns, estimate risk or measure policy effects.
An engineering or computer science application optimizing wireless communications, energy systems, machine learning algorithms, security or vehicle routing.
A legal, medical, management or historical paper reviewing policy, institutional practice or philosophical arguments.
